About Me

Multimedia Artist  /  Software Engineer

Jiatong Yao is a multimedia artist working at the intersection of culture and emerging technologies, creating immersive works across performance, sculpture, video, generative AI, XR, metaverse environments, and interactive systems. With background in computer science and professional experience as a software engineer, Yao brings a systems-level understanding to her artistic practice.

Her practice explores hybrid bodies and post-cyborg conditions shaped by contemporary technological infrastructures, examining how culture, emotion, and social behavior evolve within hybrid physical–virtual spaces.

Her work has been exhibited internationally across the United States, Europe, Asia, and South America, including national and international platforms such as Dallas Aurora, as well as WebXR and metaverse-based exhibitions. Recent projects including SolarScape, Cclaygroundd, and Toothopia investigate new social rituals and alternative forms of community in digital culture, inviting viewers to imagine more sensitive and humane ways of coexisting with technology.
